snippet.title: Moroi - Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
THE COSMIC ENGINE WELCOMES YOU. MOROI IS OUT NOW.

A grimdark fairy tale of humor and horror, Moroi will take you on a sanity-spanning journey across infinity. Fight your way out of the Cosmic Engine with weapons as inhumane as they are efficient. Puzzle your way through Moroi's grotesque halls of existential eternity. And maybe, just maybe, you'll know what it's like to be human again.

Moroi is available now on Steam: https://steamcommunity.com/app/2518410/discussions/
